products.name: Moveworks
products.note: Employee support automation; IT service desk agent; enterprise-grade access controls

profile_text.body:
Moveworks, headquartered in Mountain View, describes itself as an AI assistant platform designed to help workforces find answers and automate tasks across business applications. The platform supports search and automation across systems including Slack, OneDrive, Google Drive, SharePoint, Confluence, Outlook, and more than 50 others, and operates in over 100 languages. Employees can access it through chat, web, intranet, portals, and mobile interfaces, and the company says it delivers built-in capabilities without requiring model tuning, prompt chaining, or advanced engineering.

The core technical component Moveworks describes is its Reasoning Engine, an agentic system that orchestrates large language models and built-in tools to understand, plan, execute, and adapt to enterprise requests end-to-end. The platform includes hundreds of plugins and connectors, low-code and vibe-code tool builders, and analytics for platform management. Moveworks has a noted partnership with ServiceNow, with the two companies described as working together and being evaluated jointly as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI Applications in IT Service Management. Moveworks was also named a Challenger in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Artificial Intelligence Applications in IT Service Management on its own. Toyota's Shrini Arole and a representative from Micron are cited among customer references on the site.

The site notes that 78 percent of executives report major operational transformation with frontline employees leading the charge, a figure drawn from a report Moveworks references. The held facts confirm Moveworks maintains a tracked product in the enterprise AI platforms and agent orchestration category, covering employee support automation, IT service desk capabilities, and enterprise-grade access controls.
